en:
Really? That's nice to hear. So you've seen me do my palm
readings on celebrities, huh?
Yes, and I've always wondered what you would say about me.

Oh, yeah? Well, now's your chance to find out! Let's have a
look.
Really!? You wouldn't mind?
Of course not. Hold out your hand.
Let's see.

Oh, look at that. You have a cross on your heart line,
what's called an embroilment mark. That's pretty rare.
What? An embroilment mark? What's that?

It means that you often get caught up in the trouble of
those around you, even though you yourself haven't done
anything wrong. Sound familiar?

Yes, incredibly. That's amazing. Your readings really are as
accurate as they say! What else does my palm tell you?

Let's see. What else? Oh! Would you look at these! This is
unusual, too.

Grief lines. They show just how much pain and sadness you've
been through. Does that seem accurate?
Yes, I'm afraid it does, more than I'd care to admit.

Yeah? Well, it's pretty uncommon for someone of your young
age to have been through so much already.

People with these lines have had some difficult experiences,
but on the other hand, they're often big-hearted and kind.
Is that you?
Oh, I don't know. I guess it isn't really for me to say.

Haha, I guess you've got me there. Wait a minute! Look at
this!
It's just about time to go, Shimada-san!
Oh, okay! Thanks.
Oh, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to take up your time.
No, that's all right. Hey, good luck on the Princess League.

I've been on a few shows with your opponent, T-Set. They
take a lot of pride in their work, don't they? You may have
a tough time beating them.
Yes, I'm afraid you might be right.

To tell the truth, they're the most professional of all the
idols I've worked with. They had the show's format and all
their lines down pat.

They make it look easy, but I can tell they really put in a
lot of time and effort behind the scenes.
Yes, I agree. Who knows if I even have a shot against them.

Aw, don't give up now. You may have been through a lot, but
those experiences have made you stronger.

To tell the truth, my career as a comedian didn't take off
for quite a while. Until then, my life was pretty rough, to
say the least.

But I believe those experiences made me who I am today. So
keep at it, Haruka-chan! Don't give up!
All right. I won't!
Well, see you!
Thank you, Shimada-san!
(Shimada-san is just as nice in person as he seems on TV.)

(So T-Set is very serious and professional, huh? I bet
they've put in incredible amounts of effort.)

(If I want any shot at all of beating them, I'll have to put
in even more hard work than they do!)
All right. See you soon for recording.
(Phew. I'm all done.)
Oh, Haruka-chan. How have you been?
Hello, Shimada-san. I've been fine. Thank you for last time!

You're very welcome. Hey, have you found the confidence you
need to take down T-Set?

Well, to be honest, I still don't know if I can beat them,
but I'm doing everything I can to get ready.

You have a new, determined air about you, too! Here, hold
out your palm.
Huh? But you've already read my palm...

But your lines are always changing. Your palm is like a
mirror that shows who you are at the moment. If you change,
your lines change with you.
What do you see?
Incredible...!
What? What is it?
Amazing! You have a star sign!
A star sign?

Yes, it's a mark that comes up suddenly and temporarily.
It's extremely rare.

While you have the star sign, you're practically invincible,
and everything's almost sure to play out in your favor.

That star wasn't there last time. All your hard work and
effort must've changed your frame of mind and made it
appear.
Wow. My effort made this appear?

That's right. You couldn't have gotten a better reading just
now! It means you have a great chance at the Princess League final round!
Wow. That makes me really happy to hear.

And now, because of the star mark, the embroilment mark and
grief lines I saw last time can be interpreted in a positive
way.

I see the suffering you've endured in the past as bolstering
your star's brilliance.
Wow. It'd be amazing if all the bad things that have happened over the course of my life were actually helping me right now.

Wouldn't it? Well, I'd better be going. Good luck in the
final round!

Oh, by the way, there was one more thing I forgot to tell
you.
Really? What's that?
I saw something else of significance in your palm.
Something else? What did you see?
Hmm. Maybe it's best if you don't know...
Please tell me! I won't get upset, no matter what it is!

Well, all right. If you insist. I saw that your Mount of
Venus is prominent. That can indicate romance or
sensuality.
Mount of Venus?
Romance or sensuality!? Me? No way!

Hahaha! What a wonderful thing youth is! Anyway, I'll be
seeing you!
Shimada-san! Hmph...
(But, wow. All in all, I got a really great reading!)

(So if a person changes, the lines on their palm change,
too! Maybe I really have changed.)

(I don't exactly feel different, but I hope I've grown in
some way. Ooh, I just have to do well in that final round!)

So you understand the procedure for filming? All right.
We're through here, then. Thank you!
Thank you very much for everything.

(Phew. The meeting's all done. I guess I'd better head back
to the agency.)
Oh! Haruka-chan...?
Um, that's me.

It's me, Mitsuyo Fukai, from Cloudy Production. We were on a
a location shoot together the other day, remember?
(Uh-oh. I don't really remember her.)
Busy as usual, I see! You're working here again today?

Yes, I just finished a meeting about my next location shoot.
I was just about to leave.

Oh, well, I was about to head to the studio to record for a
variety show, but I'll basically just be sitting in the
peanut gallery.
That sounds fun, though.

Oh, how I wish I tried to get on the Princess League! I
doubt I could've won, but I might've been able to hang in
there for at least a few rounds.

At least that way, I could've had a little more TV exposure
like you!

Ooh! And if by some miracle I actually won, I could've gone
on to be a huge success! Haha! Is that your dream, too?
Uh... Mhm.

Huh? For real? You mean you're actually serious about trying
to win the whole thing?
Well, of course. That's why I've been working so hard.

You're really serious!? I don't know about that. After all, you're
up against T-Set! Those girls are in a league of their own.

They've got the looks, and their singing and dancing is
outstanding. They have first-rate coaches, too.

Natural ability, hard work, and money. Those girls really
have it all! If you ask me, there isn't much hope of beating them.
Yes, T-Set is amazing. I agree.

Right? T-Set is the reason I avoided going to the Princess
League this year.

My manager said it'd be a waste of time to even try. I was
pretty disappointed, but I have to admit she was probably right.

I don't think you should let yourself get your hopes too
high, either, you know?
Excuse me, but I have to go now.
Oh, hold on. I've got something good to tell you!

Don't tell anyone I told you this, but I hear those T-Set
girls are doing the ol' pillow dance with the Princess
League producer.
Pillow what?

You know! Sleeping their way to the top! That's why
victory's already guaranteed for them.

I bet the producer manipulates the points on the show's
concert battles, too.

Still, I've got to hand it to those girls. I mean, they'd do
absolutely anything to get ahead, you know? That's an act I
could never hope to follow.
You know, I don't believe any of that's true.
Huh? What are you talking about?

The T-Set girls would never do anything like that to get
ahead. Who told you that?

Well, um, I mean, everybody just assumes it! After all, that
producer is always playing favorites with them!

You can't go around spreading horrible rumors like that
based solely on an assumption! They actually hate that kind
of thing. One of them even saved me from it.

Geez. You don't have to get all bent out of shape. And
keep your voice down. I'm just telling you what I heard.

Just forget it. I'm not wasting any more of my time on you.
I have to get to the studio!

You just go right on sucking up to T-Set and trying to share
their spotlight. Good luck with that!

(I can't believe such an awful rumor about T-Set is going
around! It's horrible.)
Well, that's it for rehearsal. Do you have any questions?
No, no questions. I'm looking forward to the show.

Yes, me, too! I must say, Haruka-chan, I'm very impressed.
It's amazing how far up you've come in such a short time.

I've been the Princess League host for a long time, but not many
have had the momentum you've had. You must be practicing
twice as hard as everyone else.

Oh, I don't know about that. I can't compare myself to
others. All I know is that I'm doing the best I can.

Heheh, good for you! I love your attitude. Girls like you
are what make the show great and make it shine.

If you want to know why I've hosted the show for so long and
it's continued to be so popular, it's that right there.
We're all captivated by people like you.
Captivated?

Yes, captivated by the fascinating spectacle of you
beautiful young ladies giving your absolute all to make your
dreams come true.

It's mesmerizing to watch you hone your skills and vie
against one another, sometimes winning, sometimes losing.
Simply put, the performances are always entrancing.

Younger girls who watch you on TV are drawn to it, too, and
in turn they go on to become the next generation of idols.
It's absolutely fascinating, don't you think?

Gee, you're very serious about all of this, aren't you? I'm
a little surprised, to tell the truth.

Haha. Sorry about the speech. I guess I'm sort of different
from how I appear on TV, huh?
Hehe, a little, yes.

By the way, do you know how long the Princess League has
been on the air?
No, I'm sorry. I'm afraid I don't.

Oh, no need to apologize! After all, it's been on since
before you were even born.

The Princess League first aired about twenty years ago. I'm
the third host the show has had.
Wow, it's been on that long?

Pretty surprising, huh? But throughout the years, a lot of
big-name idols have gotten their start on this program.

That's what kind of legacy and influence the Princess League
has. So your being on the show now is really a huge
opportunity for you!

When the previous host handed the show over to me, he told
me, "The Princess League stage is the hallowed ground of
dreams."

He told me it was our duty to provide this important site
for girls to pursue their aspirations to become idols.

As a complete greenhorn to TV, his words made me realize
what a big responsibility I had, and made me value my new
work all the more.
Dolce-san...

But you participants in the Princess League have a duty to
uphold, as well.
We do?

It's up to you to give the next generation of girls hope
that they, too, can follow their dreams as they watch you up
on that stage.

You see, a dream isn't something you use and toss aside.
It's more like a baton in a relay race. You have to pass it
on. That's what I believe, anyway.
And so, I wish you the very best of luck, Haruka-chan.
Thank you, Dolce-san! I'll do my best to pass on my dream!

Heheh, pardon the lecture. I'm done now. I'll see you at the
show!

(Wow. Dolce-san is so much more serious than I ever would
have guessed. I'll have to make sure I'm just as serious and
responsible as he is!)

And that's the general outline of how the show will go. Are
you all set now?
Now to meet with Nomu-san...
Oh, hey, Nomu-san!
Hello, Nomu-san. How are you?
Oh, hello. I always "love to see you smile," Haruka-chan.
Come to think of it, you're from Dyna Chair, aren't ya?
Yes, that's right. Why do you ask?
It's just that you remind me of her.
I remind you of someone?

Yes, there's somethin' about ya that makes me think of your
president when she was young.
Really? Park-san?

That's right. I've been host of this show for a long time,
but back when I first started out, Park-chan appeared as a
guest a few times.

We were both really new to the business, so we couldn't
quite find our rhythm together. Haha. It's kind of
embarrassing, really.
But over the course of a long career, I guess you're bound to have a few flubs here and there.
Wow. Park-san was on your show, too.

Ya know, I really thought she was gonna take off more. She
had such promise.
